WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS mean_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes AS t
  WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.observstation
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(sa.mean_bandusagepct) AS mean_bandwidth_usage,
       AVG(sa.mean_bandusagepct - oa.mean_bandusagepct) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM station_averages AS sa
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE sa.mean_bandusagepct > oa.mean_bandusagepct;
